## Scripts

Similarly, scripts can be executed and the results displayed:

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "..")
from scripts.label import label_data

examples = pd.DataFrame({"Description": [
    "The breach exposed full names, email addresses and phone numbers.",
    "Attackers obtained bcrypt password hashes and API tokens.",
    "Medical records including diagnoses were left in a public bucket.",
    "A misconfigured server exposed internal build logs.",
]})

label_data(examples)[[
    "Description",
    "has_personal_data",
    "has_special_categories",
    "has_credentials",
]]
```
